in_sanskrit.name: Apurvitha
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Pioneer, Innovator
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Apurvitha एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Apurvitha is a Sanskrit name for a girl. The name is derived from the words 'apurva' meaning pioneer or innovator and 'itha' meaning home. This name signifies a girl who will bring new ideas and innovations to her family and community.
